To understand the policies of Benjamin Netanyahu's government, we must recall
that the Israeli prime minister is the political heir of Ze'ev Jabotinsky, the
founder of the Revisionist Zionist movement, [one of whose aides was
Netanyahu's father](https://www.newyorker.com/magazine/1998/05/25/benjamin-
netanyahu-the-
outsider#rid=46c08ec2-6312-4160-b6f5-c64ef0c4cbd0&q=the+outsider+remnick),
Benzion. Jabotinsky outlined Israel's stark reality in an
[essay](https://en.jabotinsky.org/media/9747/the-iron-wall.pdf) in 1923 titled
"The Iron Wall."
